snippet.title: Kevin Park
snippet.description:
Hey y'all Kevin here - welcome to my channel! Here's a little bit about me:
1. Brewing coffee in the morning is one of my favorite moments of the day. I love trying new beans from different roasters and my go to at a new shop is a classic cortado!
2. I lived in Ohio for a year and fell in love with country music!
3. Born and raised in Southern California, I get excited about authentic, & quality tacos.

My technical background is in aerospace engineering and manufacturing operations. I am a techie turned entrepreneur and have had the privilege of working at amazing companies like Apple and Amazon in the past. Outside of work, I am passionate about investing, business analysis, and emerging technologies (especially space!).

You can connect with me at operationskevin@gmail.com

snippet.title: Max Anton Schneider
snippet.description:
Hi, ich bin Max.

Ich lebe mit ADHS und Asperger, bin Christ, Solopreneur und baue digitale Produkte. Auf diesem Kanal teile ich offen meine Journey: was ich baue, was ich lerne, wo ich scheitere und wie ich versuche, als neurodivergenter Mensch ein ehrliches, ruhigeres und unabhängigeres Leben aufzubauen.

Aktuell baue ich meinsystem.app, eine App für Menschen mit ADHS, Autismus und AuDHS, die weniger Overload im Kopf und mehr Struktur im Alltag wollen.

Hier geht es um Software, Solopreneurship, Neurodivergenz, Glaube, Minimalismus und den echten Weg dahinter.

Neues Video jeden Sonntag um 18:30 Uhr.

snippet.title: Moritz | AI Systems
snippet.description:
Hey I'm Moritz. I'm a German engineer with over 10 years experience in tech. I've worked in several software startups in product management roles. A few years ago, I quit my job to start my own business, and since then I've been building with AI.

Now I build custom AI agent systems for businesses — helping teams automate work, get more clients, and move faster without adding headcount.

On this channel, you'll find:

- How to deploy AI agents in real businesses
- Tutorials and experiments with agent frameworks and tools
- My personal journey of quitting my job and building businesses with AI

My goal is to make AI agents accessible to businesses — and show what's possible in this new era. 

Thanks for being here!
